notes.kicker: note - how these renders were produced
body: A widget-test harness; zero app code touched. It pumps the real GenericProfilePage with LmsProfileSections.registerStudentSections(...) registered, renders it at 390 logical px (dpr 3) at the page's full content height, and captures the RepaintBoundary to PNG.

The data is the SDKs' own demo data, not fixtures written for this page. The test runs with --dart-define=IS_DEMO=true and calls the SDKs' DI registrations, so LmsSdkDependencies installs DemoLmsRepository and SeededTutorCatalog and AuthSdkDependencies installs MockAuthRepository - the same demo fixtures a demo build of the app serves.

Real, not simulated: Inter/Montserrat loaded as real font files through the google_fonts test path, the real MaterialIcons and Remix icon fonts, and AppStyle light/dark tokens resolved by the real setBrightness seam. Layout, spacing, typography, colour, registry order and visibility gates are all the shipped code path.

notes.kicker: exception - device history the demo mode cannot supply
body: The profile's attendance percentage and library come from stores a device accumulates through use: ProfileStore's attendance ledger is written by the schedule as lessons are attended, and DemoLmsRepository.recordAttendanceEvent is a deliberate no-op. A widget test never walks that journey, so those stores start empty.

This page therefore seeds the attendance ledger and library through the app's REAL store API (harness marker 3/8). The percentages, averages and expandable summaries on the frames are still computed by the app's own notifiers from those records - nothing on the frame is a typed-in number. Every other value comes from demo mode.

notes.kicker: found by rendering (a drawing could not have caught these)
items: The footer's backend probe fails headlessly, so it renders the real Offline state - and one usage string surfaces an untranslated key (DaysInAppThisYear).
The demo persona's email ellipsises at this width - real overflow behaviour, invisible in a drawing.
The gap above the footer is the real lms.nav_clearance spacer (94px) for the floating nav pill, not padding.
